The governance

One human sets the mission and direction; AI does the rest. The harness of gates and rules builds and steers everything below it. The director’s words carry full authority; a question to him comes with a recommendation.

Read each column top to bottom as a list, not a chain. The mark in each box is read from the maturity map at publish: . done, _ in build, ~ not started.

Where to see it working

  • How it’s built — the rules, the gates and the record of what he asked for.
  • Capabilities — what the machine has built under this governance.
  • Explore — what it produces.
  • The code — the harness’s own modules.
